diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~200% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 12): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests.
